02 · SCOPE OF WORK

What's Included

Everything below is bundled into the price on page 6. Labor, equipment, debris haul-off, and on-site management are included.

#PHASEWORK INCLUDED
01Site Clearing & DemoRemove existing grass, debris, and old surfacing across the work area. Haul off and dispose.
02Grading & Base PrepCut, fill, and compact the sub-grade. Lay and compact a draining aggregate base to spec.
03Paver InstallationSet 2,720 sq ft of Angelus pavers (Sandstone Copper) over bedding sand with proper slope for drainage; cut, seat, and compact.
04Artificial TurfInstall 1,230 sq ft of Marathon synthetic grass over the prepared base; seam, stake, and infill for a natural look.
05Edging & BordersInstall concrete or paver borders to lock the field in place and keep clean transitions.
06Final DetailingJoint sand, power-wash, blow-off, and final walkthrough. Site left clean and punch-list closed.
MATERIALS & SELECTIONS

Pavers: Angelus Pavilion / Paseo, color Sandstone Copper — supplied & installed.
Artificial Turf: Marathon synthetic grass, premium landscape grade — supplied & installed.
Base & Edging: Compacted, draining aggregate base under both surfaces, with concrete / paver borders.

HOW WE DO THE JOB
  • Compacted, draining aggregate base under everything.
  • Proper slope so water runs off, never pools.
  • Edges locked with borders so nothing shifts.
  • Site cleaned and hauled off when we leave.
LICENSED, INSURED, SPECIALIZED
  • CSLB License #1129259, Class B General Building.
  • Outdoor renovation only: paving, fencing, hardscape.
  • General liability and workers' comp on file.

HOW THE BASE GOES DOWN

We grade and compact the sub-grade, then lay and compact a draining aggregate base before any pavers or turf go in. A solid base is what keeps the finished surface flat and stops settling over time.
